trigger: v3 saved residual/source review found abrupt processed speed changes; missing leading digits is an unconfirmed hypothesis, not grounds to remove points
decision_rules: preserve raw images, clock, hashes and old CSV unchanged
do not infer missing digits, interpolate or correct from model residuals
if display differs, distinguish seek/filter offsets, OCR/body error and public telemetry anomaly; remain uncertain if unavailable
any changed accepted reference or mask requires a separate version before further calibration; prior v3 results keep original gates/masks
not blind or an estimate of population OCR error rate
cleanup: retain originals; hash/archive/restore before deletion; no public push, no whole-broadcast copy
